notes.title: Update 2.3
notes.content:
Pilots, it’s time to elevate your experience with our latest update! We've been hard at work making the sim smoother, more realistic, and packed with exciting new features. From overhauled physics and customizable drone components to improved controls, this update is designed to give you even more control, creativity, and fun.

Whether you're perfecting your tricks, diving into multiplayer action, or designing the ultimate map, there's something here for everyone. Check out the full patch notes below for all the details!

[h2]Physics v2[/h2]

With physics improvements focused on aerodynamic accuracy and thrust dynamics, your drone will respond exactly how you expect in any situation.

[list]
[*] The 3D model of your drone, including battery size and HD camera dimensions, now plays a key role in fluid dynamics calculations
[*] Enhanced Motor Thrust Accuracy: Motor performance has been fine-tuned for improved precision.
[*] Significant improvements in the simulation of battery voltage drop.
[*] You can seamlessly switch between Physics v2 and your current Physics v1 settings.
[/list]

[h2]New Season Begins![/h2]

The pre-season is over, and it’s time to take your skills to the leaderboard! Compete, climb the ranks, and earn exclusive rewards as you prove yourself among the best pilots. Stay tuned—more details coming soon!


[h3]Patch note[/h3]
[list]
[*] Physics v2
[*] Collision size now accurately updates based on drone dimensions.
[*] Updated Wind Sound
[*] Drone Settings Update : you can now customize your drone by selecting individual components.
[*] Improved multiplayer double reset system during multiplayer races.
[*] Controller Rework : Assign up to 8 axes and 20 buttons for custom actions such as reset, arm/disarm, flight mode selection, and more.
[*] New Bindable Actions :
 - Added disarm button/axis.
 - Flight mode
 - Button/axis to save the current location for future respawn points.
[*] Added throttle expo and mid-point adjustment settings.
[*] Map Editor :
 - Added 8 new wall-type blocks for more creative map designs.
 - Added a new button to display a full-size menu of map editor blocks.
[*]Crash Physics Upgrade
 - Reduced bounciness and random rotations during low-speed crashes.
 - Improved sliding dynamics for trick executions on surfaces.
[*]Analog Signal Simulation
 - Added an option for analog signal simulation to enhance realism.
[*]New Races
 - 2 new races in City Park.
 - 1 new race in The Dock.
[*] Added a drone pilot model at your spawn point.
[*] Fixed profanity filter issues, now allowing terms like “analog VTX” to pass as intended.
[/list]
Don't hesitate to share your thoughts and join the conversation on our [url=https://discord.gg/pSjjUe4KS4]Discord[/url] channel.

notes.title: Environment & Track Editor
notes.content:
We're excited to announce the release of our highly anticipated Environment & Track Editor! This powerful new feature empowers players to create, customize, and share their own maps and tracks, bringing a new level of creativity and personalization to Uncrashed.
Effortlessly create and customize environments using an intuitive interface designed for both beginners and experienced users and publish your maps and tracks for the community to enjoy, or browse and download creations from other players.

Dive into the Environment & Track Editor now and start creating your dream maps and tracks. We can’t wait to see the amazing creations you’ll bring to the Uncrashed community!

[h3]Bug Fixes and Improvements[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Updated[/b] the icon for the last checkpoint/finish line.
[*] [b]Resolved[/b] an issue where players remained unranked after completing more than 10 races.
[*] [b]Corrected[/b] the size of the controllable drift cars to the appropriate scale.
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] a vehicle crash issue occurring in "The Dock" map.
[*] [b]Minimap Zoom[/b] : Added the ability to zoom in on the minimap within the pause menu.
[*] [b]Few optimizations[/b] for the "Horizon" map.
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] the problem of the ground disappearing in the "Horizon" map.
[*] [b]Added[/b] a the display of your top percentage on the leaderboard.
[/list]


Don't hesitate to share your thoughts and join the conversation on our [url=https://discord.gg/pSjjUe4KS4]Discord channel.[/url]

notes.title: Hotfix 2.22
notes.content:
[h2]Hotfix[/h2]

[list]
[*] Introduced an option for displaying an artificial horizon.

[*] Enhanced the reset system in multiplayer races; respawning will now face the next gates, and double-tapping reset will return you to the last validated checkpoint.
[*] Resolved an issue where players could get stuck when entering spectate mode with no available targets.
[*] Implemented AFK detection: Players inactive for over 30 seconds in races or more than 3 minutes in free flight will be automatically removed.

notes.title: Hotfix 2.21
notes.content:
[h2]Hotfix[/h2]

[list]
[*] Resolved a problem where players weren't placed at the starting point at the beginning of a race.
[*] Fixed a race start issue affecting the 7th and 8th players in some races.
[*] Fixed a conflict involving the "S" shortcut key for spectating during races.
[*] Multiplayer sessions now organized by privacy settings, game mode, and latency for easier navigation.
[*] Sessions with excessively high latency are now excluded from search results to improve gameplay experience.
[*] Session listings in the session browser have been compacted, allowing for more sessions to be displayed on a single screen.
[*] Introduced color coding to indicate session latency, making it easier to choose the best sessions.
[*] Enhanced the matchmaking system for more efficient pairing in quickplay.
[*] Reduced stuttering when spectating players with high latency.
[*] Corrected an issue causing cars to get stuck on the dock map.
[*] Addressed a bug where players could appear multiple times in the race-ending leaderboard.
[*] Eliminated a problem where the same race could be offered as a voting option twice at the end of a map.
[*] Fixed a visibility issue with drones at the race's end gate to other players.
[*] Added /help and /kick chat commands.
[*] Decreased the waiting time between races in multiplayer mode.
[*] Adjusted the position of the first checkpoint in the Horizon→Construction Site.
[*] Resolved a bug preventing the camera angle settings from being saved after changing maps.
[*] Flight modes (ACRO/Angle/3D) preferences are now retained across maps.
[*] Removed high wind conditions in the Mountain Open - Snow weather setting for more consistent flight conditions.
[*] Temporarily disabled drone collisions in multiplayer to address issues during race starts and respawns. We welcome your feedback on this change!
[*] Added a button to cancel reconnection attempts to a host.
[*] Fixed a critical error that could cause the game to crash at the end of a race. If you encounter this issue, please contact us via email or [url=https://discord.gg/DYvnsAJmaF]Discord[/url] with detailed information. Thank you for your support!
[/list]

notes.title: MULTIPLAYER
notes.content:
Many of you might have inferred from our recent patch notes, which introduced leaderboards, that multiplayer was the natural progression. Your requests for this feature have not gone unnoticed, and we are pleased to announce its arrival. Dive into the excitement of free-flying,  engage in races with friends, or aim for leaderboard supremacy. With multiplayer, training becomes an immersive and exciting journey !

[h2]Key features[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Multiplayer[/b]: Dive into the action with friends or competitors in our newly launched multiplayer mode.
[*] [b]New Menu UI[/b]: Redesigned menu interface
[*] [b]Christmas Carnival/Longrage Map[/b]: The Christmas Carnival/Longrage map has been renamed to "Grassland"
[*] [b]Props in View Option[/b]: Added ability to display props in view.
[*] [b]Map Optimization[/b]: Improved performance on some maps and adjusted weather lighting for better visuals.
[*][b]Controllable Car[/b]: Drive a controllable car in single and multiplayer modes.
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Imperial or Metric Selection[/b]: Fixed the choice between imperial or metric systems.
[*] [b]Yaw Power Correction[/b]: Fixed a bug where yaw was providing excessive power at very high rates, 
[*] [b]Rainy Weather Car Lights[/b]: Fixed car lights not displaying correctly in rainy conditions.
[/list]

Thanks to your support, Uncrashed continues to grow. We are committed to maintaining this momentum and are already in the process of planning additional updates for the future !
Feel free to come to [url=https://discord.gg/DYvnsAJmaF]our discord[/url] for any suggestions or bug reports.

notes.title: UNCRASHED 2.0
notes.content:
In this latest version of Uncrashed, we're excited to introduce a host of enhancements and new features. Explore the newly added Meadow map, a big landscape with farms, mills, fishing villages, and ruins.
We haven't forgotten about our existing maps either; many have received significant updates. Notably, Forest-bando now includes a large, abandoned area.
For drone racing fans, we've added leaderboards for a more competitive experience, and you can now race against replays from friends or top players


[h2]Key Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Leaderboard & VERSUS Mode[/b] : Now you can challenge your friends or top players! Select a replay from the leaderboard and race head-to-head.
[*] [b]Interactive Map Feature[/b] : Simply hit "M" to bring up a map of your current environment. You can instantly teleport to your preferred spots or race tracks.
[*] [b]Weather Selection[/b] : Choose your favorite weather in most environments, bright sunshine,  sunsets or even rain.
[*] [b]New map - Meadow[/b] : Fly through a vast environment of farms, mills, fishing villages and ruins.
[*] [b]Stadium FMX[/b] : Follow the freestyle motocross on the different jumps in a variation of the stadium map.
[*] [b]Revamped maps[/b] : We've given a fresh look to several maps including Forest-bando, Desert, Mountain Open, Arctic Island, Longrange, and added a child playground in Horizon.
[*] [b]Turtle mode[/b] : for faster restart without pressing reset.
[*] [b]Enhanced Race UI[/b]
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Key Binding[/b] : Keyboard keys can now be bound to reset without restrictions.
[*] [b]Drone Reset Stability[/b] : Drones no longer flip over upon reset.
[*] [b]Various small issues[/b] have also been addressed for a smoother experience.
[/list]

In this latest update, we have reworked a significant part of the simulator's internal code. This opens the way for the introduction of more complex functions in the near future. Stay tuned for others updates coming in early 2024!

We're grateful for your continued support and enthusiasm. Your feedback and suggestions are invaluable to us.
Don't hesitate to share your thoughts and join the conversation on [url=https://discord.gg/DYvnsAJmaF]our Discord channel.[/url]
Stay tuned !
